tools.name: calypso-list-buckets
tools.description:
[CALYPSO LIST BUCKETS]
Lists buckets for the team tied to the configured Calypso API key.

Use this before uploads when you need bucket ids, slugs, names, member counts,
or bucket-store readiness. This complements RAG model discovery: model discovery
shows which buckets are bound to each agent variant, while this tool lists all buckets for the API key team.

includeArchived.description: If true, include archived buckets. Defaults to false.

tools.name: calypso-get-file
tools.description:
[CALYPSO GET FILE]
Fetches one knowledge file's metadata and indexing status by file id.

Use this to resolve the opaque `fileIds` returned by calypso-list-buckets
into filename, mime type, size, indexing status, and per-bucket sync state.
Pass verify=true to also ask the provider (Gemini) for ground truth about
the indexed document — slower, but authoritative when status looks stale.

fileId.description: Knowledge file id, e.g. from calypso-list-buckets fileIds.

verify.description: If true, verify against the provider (?verify=gemini). Slower.

tools.name: calypso-create-bucket
tools.description:
[CALYPSO CREATE BUCKET]
Creates an empty bucket to upload files into later.

Use this for the create-then-fill workflow; uploads can also create
buckets implicitly via bucketSlugs + createMissingBuckets. The server
normalizes the slug and returns 409 `bucket_slug_exists` on collision.
Requires the `knowledge:bucket:create` capability on the API key and a
backend with POST /v1/knowledge/buckets deployed.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key; replays return the existing bucket.

tools.name: calypso-create-agent
tools.description:
[CALYPSO CREATE AGENT]
Creates a RAG agent variant bound to one or more buckets.

The success payload leads with `model` — pass it straight to
calypso-rag-agent. Bucket bindings are validated server-side
(`bucket_not_found` for unknown or archived buckets), agent ids are
slug-normalized (`agent_id_exists` on collision), and the plan's agent
cap is enforced (`agent_limit_reached` when full). Requires the
`rag:agent:create` capability and a backend with
POST /v1/rag-agent/agents deployed.

agentId.description: Optional agent id; slug rules, server-normalized.

bucketIds.description: Bucket ids to bind. Provide bucketIds and/or bucketSlugs.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key; replays return the existing agent.

tools.name: calypso-upload-file
tools.description:
[CALYPSO UPLOAD FILE]
Uploads a file into the durable bucket-backed knowledge store and indexing pipeline.

Use this when you want a file indexed into the broader knowledge corpus instead of
attached directly to a single RAG chat turn. This tool returns file and task metadata.
A bucket destination is required: pass bucketIds, bucketSlugs, or bucket.
Choose exactly one file source. Use `filePath` when this MCP server runs locally and can read the path, including Claude Desktop or Cursor configs that launch this package with npx. Use `contentBase64` for hosted or remote MCP clients, browser uploads, generated in-memory content, or remote sandbox files that this MCP process cannot read. Do not base64-encode local files just to use this tool.

filename.description: Display filename for the uploaded knowledge file.

mimeType.description: Content type for the uploaded knowledge file.

filePath.description: Preferred for local MCP installs, including Claude Desktop and Cursor configs that run this package with a local command such as npx. Absolute or relative path readable by the machine running this MCP server. The server reads raw bytes and uploads them through the Calypso upload-session URL; no user-side base64 conversion is needed.

contentBase64.description: Inline file bytes as base64. Use when filePath is not possible, such as hosted or remote MCP servers, browser-provided files, generated content, or remote sandbox attachment paths that the MCP process cannot read.

title.description: Optional human-readable title stored with the knowledge file.

metadata.description: Optional metadata object serialized onto the upload request.

bucketIds.description: Existing knowledge bucket ids to assign this upload to. Required unless bucketSlugs or bucket is provided.

bucketSlugs.description: Knowledge bucket slugs to assign this upload to. Required unless bucketIds or bucket is provided.

bucket.description: Convenience single bucket slug for this upload. Required unless bucketIds or bucketSlugs is provided.

createMissingBuckets.description: If true, create missing bucket slugs before assignment.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for durable upload retries.

waitForIndexing.description: If true, wait until indexing reaches a terminal ready state before returning.

tools.name: calypso-upload-files-batch
tools.description:
[CALYPSO UPLOAD FILES BATCH]
Uploads 1 to 100 files into the durable knowledge store and indexing queue in one request.

Use this for bulk corpus ingestion. Shared bucket fields apply to every item unless an item
provides its own bucket fields. The tool returns batch-level status and, when requested,
polls until the batch reaches active, partially_active, partially_failed, failed, or timeout.
A shared bucket destination is required unless every item provides its own bucket destination.
Choose exactly one file source per item. Use `filePath` when this MCP server runs locally and can read each path, including Claude Desktop or Cursor configs that launch this package with npx. Use `contentBase64` for hosted or remote MCP clients, browser uploads, generated in-memory content, or remote sandbox files that this MCP process cannot read. Do not base64-encode local files just to use this tool.

filename.description: Display filename for this knowledge file.

mimeType.description: Content type for this knowledge file.

filePath.description: Preferred for local MCP installs, including Claude Desktop and Cursor configs that run this package with a local command such as npx. Absolute or relative path readable by the machine running this MCP server. The server reads raw bytes and uploads them through the Calypso upload-session URL; no user-side base64 conversion is needed.

contentBase64.description: Inline file bytes as base64. Use when filePath is not possible, such as hosted or remote MCP servers, browser-provided files, generated content, or remote sandbox attachment paths that the MCP process cannot read.

clientFileId.description: Optional Firestore-safe id for this batch item. Omit to generate one from filename and item position.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for this item.

bucketIds.description: Existing bucket ids for this item. Required when no shared bucket destination is provided.

bucketSlugs.description: Bucket slugs for this item. Required when no shared bucket destination is provided.

bucket.description: Convenience single bucket slug for this item. Required when no shared bucket destination is provided.

createMissingBuckets.description: If true, create missing bucket slugs for this item before assignment.

items.description: Knowledge files to upload in this batch.

batchIdempotencyKey.description: Required idempotency key used to derive the durable batch id.

bucketIds.description: Existing bucket ids applied to all items by default. Required unless every item has a bucket destination.

bucketSlugs.description: Bucket slugs applied to all items by default. Required unless every item has a bucket destination.

bucket.description: Convenience single bucket slug applied to all items by default. Required unless every item has a bucket destination.

createMissingBuckets.description: If true, create missing shared bucket slugs before assignment.

waitForBatchReady.description: If true, poll batch status with include_items=true until terminal or timeout.

tools.name: calypso-rag-agent
tools.description:
[CALYPSO RAG AGENT]
Sends each prompt directly to the Calypso RAG agent using the full conversation context.

Use this when you want Calypso knowledge retrieval and grounded answers from the RAG backend.
Typical requests:
- "Summarize the key points from our onboarding documentation"
- "What does the knowledge base say about campaign approval rules?"
- "Compare the documented indexing flow with the retrieval flow"
- "Answer using the uploaded file ids: [\"file_123\"]"

Responses API behavior:
- First turns start a named Calypso conversation via `/v1/responses`.
- Follow-up turns chain with `previous_response_id` so the backend owns conversation state.
- When `fileIds` are provided, the MCP uses `rag_policy` retrieval semantics instead of inline attachment stuffing.

MCP session behavior:
- This tool maintains a stable conversation id in the background for multi-turn retrieval context.
- Use `/new` to start a fresh conversation and clear the current context window.

Quick commands (examples):
- "Summarize the latest indexed knowledge about WhatsApp templates"
- "Find the source of truth for campaign approval behavior"
- "Start a new topic" (or use `/new`)

The authoritative, refreshable variant list lives in the `calypso://rag-agent-models` resource — do not cache this description.

prompt.description: Your request. Include context, constraints, and desired output.

fileIds.description: Optional uploaded agent-store `file_id` values to attach with `rag_policy` retrieval semantics.

model.description: Optional RAG model variant. Defaults to `calypso-rag-agent`. Read the calypso://rag-agent-models resource for the current list.
